name: Hellas: Mythos of the Heroic Age
author: Classical Mythos Design Guild
description: Experience authentic classical Greece in the Heroic Age. Journey across Boeotia, Phocis, Argolis, and Arcadia, confronting mythical beasts and seeking divine favour.

factions.name: Plataean Wayfarers & Shepherds
factions.description: The rustic pastoral citizens dwelling in the foothills of Mount Cithaeron and Plataea.

factions.name: Theban City Guard
factions.description: The elite bronze-clad sentinels guarding the Seven Gates of Cadmean Thebes.

factions.name: Delphic Amphictyonic League
factions.description: The sacred league of priests and pilgrims protecting the Pythian Oracle of Apollo.

factions.name: Cult of Hermes Enodios
factions.description: Wayfarers, heralds, and travelers honoring the divine guide of mountain roads.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: The elderly shepherd collapses lifeless upon the stones! News of the tragic murder will spread swiftly to Plataea—travelers and herdsmen will treat you as a violent outlaw, and the quest for his lost ram is broken beyond repair.

addJournalChronicle.title: Blood on Mount Cithaeron
addJournalChronicle.text: Slew Elder Daidalos at the crossroads. The folk of Plataea now consider you a bloodstained outcast.

transcript.speaker: Spiritual Miasma
transcript.text: Striking down a pious suppliant in a sacred sanctuary brings dark spiritual pollution (miasma) upon your shade. The Delphic league will shun your inquiries, and the gods turn their faces away.

addJournalChronicle.title: Sacrilege at the Shrine
addJournalChronicle.text: Murdered Timon the suppliant at the sacred Herm. Incurred divine displeasure and severe miasma.
